title: Fruit By Supergood Mango Papaya & Passion Fruit 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Fruit by Supergood Mango, Papaya and Passion Fruit is a rich and immersive tropical experience. It brings together the juicy sweetness of Mango, the smooth, creamy notes of Papaya, and the sharp, tangy zest of Passion Fruit. It is a bold, sun-drenched flavour profile that bursts with exotic character. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is formulated for MTL vaping. It’s ideal for use with Starter vape kits and pod mods, producing dense, satisfying clouds and exceptional flavour clarity. This 100ml shortfill is supplied in a 120ml bottle, containing 100ml of 0mg e-liquid. This leaves the perfect amount of space to add two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to create 120ml of 3mg nicotine-strength e-liquid. The "Fruit" collection is the latest innovation from Supergood, a premium UK manufacturer famous for their "Butter" and "Cocktail" ranges. Moving away from heavy desserts, this range focuses on delivering the most authentic and refreshing fruit profiles imaginable.
